status: Proposed private execution contract; no owner, provider, product or public admission
scope: Own an ordinary generated-image reader and an injected IdentityLayout /2 reader. Independently decode the captured bytes in the parent and compare immutable observations through verified process/context receipts. Their correlation remains a declared fixture association, not physical identity or current storage authority.
ownership: providers/image/file_layout owns ordinary local-file capture and private values; platform/windows/storage/image_layout_worker owns the compiled role and byte channel; providers/windows/layout_provenance owns the pure evidence join. Portable decoders and runtime raw-layout meaning retain format interpretation. No shipped composition or command is added.
transport: Reuse the finite owned observation host. A compiled image-layout profile adds exactly one inherited anonymous byte section, at most the existing 16-MiB raw decoder limit, owned/duplicated before launch and never named/selected by JSON. Old profiles retain seven role arguments and no payload. Existing 786432-byte reply, 278528-byte maximum input mapping, 128-MiB reader, aggregate and 256-MiB parent limits remain unchanged. Parent copies bounded bytes after bound publication and verifies their digest before independent decoding; shared mutable bytes are not the retained observation.
capture: Pin fixed-local ordinary-file parents and a read-only handle. Bind expected before identity/generation, path, logical unit, capture epoch and optional prior content digest. Hash a complete bounded first capture, reread chunks and retain before/after metadata, errors, lengths and hashes. Partial final blocks, corruption, source change, incomplete coverage and exhausted budgets stay explicit. Equality does not establish an atomic snapshot or acquisition consistency.
typed_provenance: Immutable file/storage snapshots are constructed only by their actual owned sessions, not serialized observations or pure receipt validators. Bind PID/creation, code, request, role, observer/worker/capture epochs, content/frame/capture and both expected context digests. Join exact matching capture/subject/content/context inputs. Historical observations grant no current freshness or execution authority.
comparison: Retain the original pure comparison and its no-authentication scope. The wrapper separately verifies owned process bindings. An unstable captured source or partial final logical block cannot yield an applicable agreement: rounding capacity up does not establish the missing bytes. Missing fields/coverage, contradictions and ambiguity retain conservative outcomes. Physical source association remains unproven.
expected_checks: Actual x64/x86 ordinary-file reads and separately owned injected /2 processes; independently generated Python source bytes/metadata recipes.
MBR/EBR/both-copy GPT, 512/4096 units, more than eight rows, malformed/truncated metadata, partial final blocks and the exact 16-MiB boundary without truncation or raised limits.
Expectation mismatch, real file generation/size/path change, read/reread/metadata failures, cancellation, hung/late readers, pre/post-spawn failures and owned exit-only retirement.
Corrupt payload/layout/receipt/code/request/profile/epoch/process/context/content/claims cannot construct an owned snapshot or agreement.
Wrong subject/capture and stale expected context/digest refuse a join; original values remain immutable and comparison performs no file/device query.

Legacy no-payload role, namespace/storage/frame/frontend/lifecycle regressions pass on both binaries. Compare current product inputs to dev41 evidence; rebuild and rerun the product if its closure changes.

Exact compiler/SDK/staticCRT/build/PE/import/source/log/hash evidence and tooling/context/manifest checks; implementing-agent review. Other hosts, actual /2 windows/terminals, owner/provider/public/live/physical admission remain separate.
